# Prey
Prey, to the Yautja, are non-Yautja creatures that are deadly and intelligent enough to prove a challenge. This page covers how each type of prey is seen and how it can be hunted. See [textlink="Weapons and Tools" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodeWeapons"] for what each type allows.
## Worthy [color=#57b339][bold]Worthy:[/bold][/color] all prey is worthy unless it falls into the un-huntable classification below.
[bold]All worthy prey is to be hunted alone.[/bold]
## Un-huntable [color=#a4885c][bold]Un-huntable:[/bold][/color] prey that isn't worthy and cannot be hunted. If un-huntable prey verbally provokes you (insulting you, bossing you around or generally acting LRP towards you), attacks you, or helps its allies attack you, it becomes worthy.
- Worthy prey that is below 75% health, missing limbs or hugged. - Worthy prey dragging wounded or dead allies who were not involved in your hunt to safety. - Worthy prey that is actively in combat, before your fight with it starts. - Honored prey, if specified. This is prey that has defeated a fellow Yautja in single combat or performed a feat of strength. They may be awarded a trophy by you or from the ship, and may be held in higher regard. - GOVFOR and OPFOR ship crew. - Unarmed and civilian colonists. - Working medics. - Synths. See [textlink="Prey Caveats" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePreyCaveats"]. - The SO, XO and CO. They become worthy after the 1 hour mark, and shouldn't be permakilled unless they lead a hunting party against you. Sneaking onto the ship to hunt GOVFOR or OPFOR leadership should never be done. - Threat support castes incapable of putting up a fight: sentinels, boilers, queens, kings and the overmind.
## Dishonorable [color=#ff0000][bold]Dishonorable:[/bold][/color] prey that is innately immoral.
- Abominations and aberrations, and anyone actively defending them, including bodyblocking and other subtler ways. Use your own initiative. See [textlink="Prey Caveats" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePreyCaveats"]. - Xenomorphs that evolve into Queen on the preserve. - Dutch's Dozen. - Honor duel parties that breach the rules of an honor duel.
## Temporarily dishonorable [color=#ffbf00][bold]Temporarily dishonorable:[/bold][/color] prey that stops being dishonorable once the engagement ends. Anyone aiding them inherits the temporarily dishonorable status. Temporarily dishonorable actions aimed at only one Yautja on the hunt must be fought by that Yautja alone.
- Scientists involved in xenomorph experimentation, during a purge. - A target or group of targets attacking the prey you're currently engaging. - Shipside gear carriers and users, and anyone actively allowing the gear to stay shipside. This status lifts once all the gear is gone. - Prey on stimulants that make them unkillable or super fast. - Vehicles or aircraft attacking you or running you over. - Prey carrying or desecrating a Yautja corpse (looting, beheading, delimbing). - Prey committing LRP actions against the Yautja or metagaming the Honor Code. Do not be afraid to permakill un-huntables over egregious LRP. - Prey interrupting an honor duel or running from one. - Prey using OT or research weaponry against you. - Prey attacking you while you are cloaked. Lurkers are excluded. - Acid runners farming Yautja for acid, for example an acider who keeps landing one or two hits and running away to stay safe. Use your own initiative. - Hive offensives. See [textlink="Prey Caveats" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePreyCaveats"].
